Generate a full-extent GBIF occurrence map

Source: R/spatial_gbif.R
gbif_map.Rd

gbif_map() creates a standalone map of the georeferenced occurrences of a species, and gbif_map_md() creates the same map for a markdown-formatted report (Quarto or R Markdown).

gbif_map(
  species = NULL,
  limit = 50000L,
  mode = c("interactive", "static"),
  save_occurrences = FALSE,
  export_image = FALSE,
  directory = getwd(),
  colour = NULL,
  zoom_static = NULL,
  dpi = NULL,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  source = c("web", "local"),
  taxon_id = NULL,
  generate_doi = FALSE,
  date = NULL,
  static_legend_position = "bottomleft"
)

gbif_map_md(
  species = NULL,
  limit = 50000L,
  mode = NULL,
  save_occurrences = FALSE,
  export_image = FALSE,
  directory = getwd(),
  colour = NULL,
  zoom_static = NULL,
  dpi = NULL,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  fig_width = NULL,
  fig_height = NULL,
  source = c("web", "local"),
  taxon_id = NULL,
  generate_doi = FALSE,
  date = NULL,
  static_legend_position = "bottomleft"
)

Arguments

species

A binomial scientific name in the form "Genus species", e.g. "Bidens andicola", "Cinchona officinalis", or "Puma concolor". GBIF must resolve it as an exact species-level name; spelling variants and higher-rank matches are rejected. Supply exactly one of species or taxon_id.

limit

Maximum number of georeferenced occurrences used to draw and save, an integer between 1 and 100000, e.g. 100, 500, or 2000. With a local source, the first limit records of the saved export are used. Defaults to 50000.

mode

Map type: "interactive" (default; a Leaflet widget) or "static" (a ggplot2 map). In gbif_map_md(), NULL selects an interactive map for HTML output and a static map for other formats.

save_occurrences

Logical. If TRUE, up to limit georeferenced records are saved as occurrences.gpkg under sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species, with metadata.json describing the query. generate_doi = TRUE adds the official DOI for a registered GBIF download. Defaults to FALSE.

export_image

Logical. If TRUE, the static map is written as a PNG file to sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species. Defaults to FALSE.

directory

Base directory in which sacha_exports is created or, for a local source, searched. Occurrences and exported images are saved under sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species. Defaults to getwd().

colour

Colour of the occurrence points as a hexadecimal code with 3, 4, 6, or 8 digits, e.g. "#1B9E77". When NULL, the package default colour is used.

zoom_static

Logical. Should static maps be framed on the extent of the occurrences? It applies to static maps and exported images. When NULL, the package default is used.

dpi

Resolution of the exported PNG in dots per inch. When NULL, the package default resolution is used.

overwrite

Logical. Should existing output files be replaced? If FALSE, an existing local occurrence export raises an error. Defaults to TRUE.

source

Occurrence source: "web" (default) retrieves records from GBIF; "local" reads a saved export from sacha_exports under directory.

taxon_id

A COL XR alphanumeric species usage key, such as "Q2M4". GBIF resolves the key against the configured checklist and verifies that it identifies one species-level taxon. Supply exactly one of taxon_id or species.

generate_doi

Logical. If TRUE and source = "web", create and wait for a registered GBIF download, retrieve its DOI, and use at most limit records. This requires GBIF account credentials. If FALSE (default), use the faster occurrence-search API without waiting for a DOI. For a local source, no GBIF request is made.

date

Optional ISO date or range such as "2020-01-01,2021-01-01". It filters GBIF occurrence datasets by their registry createdDate, then filters records by the matching dataset keys. It does not filter the date on which an occurrence was observed. Local exports can use only the same date filter recorded in their metadata.

static_legend_position

Position of the static legend as one composed unit with its scale bar and north arrow. Applies to static maps and PNGs written with export_image = TRUE, including when mode is "interactive": "bottomleft" (default), "bottom", "bottomright", "right", "topright", "top", "topleft", or "left". It does not change the interactive map widget.

fig_width, fig_height

Dimensions in inches for static maps produced by gbif_map_md(). When NULL, the static map dimensions follow its aspect ratio. Interactive Leaflet maps use the widget and output container's default sizing.

Value

A Leaflet widget or a ggplot2 object. Paths of the written files are stored in the "sacha_files" attribute, the plotted records in "sacha_occurrences", and the species in "sacha_species". gbif_map_md() returns the map formatted for the report output.

Details

With source = "web" (default), supply exactly one of species or taxon_id. GBIF resolves the binomial as an exact, species-level name or validates the COL XR usage key as an exact species-level taxon. The resulting taxon key and the same checklist key are used to retrieve records with coordinates. This prevents approximate name matches and keeps records tied to one accepted GBIF taxonomic concept. With source = "local", records are read from an export previously written by save_occurrences = TRUE or by gbif_save_occurrences(), and GBIF is not contacted. Local exports are stored under sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species inside directory.

Setting save_occurrences = TRUE stores up to limit georeferenced records as a GeoPackage in WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), together with a JSON file describing the exact taxon match, query, date filter, retrieval date, coordinate reference system, and record count. By default, generate_doi = FALSE uses the fast GBIF occurrence search and does not wait for a registered download or DOI. Set generate_doi = TRUE to create and wait for a registered download; its DOI is recorded in metadata.json and in the map's sacha_gbif_download attribute. This requires GBIF_USER, GBIF_PWD, and GBIF_EMAIL credentials. With source = "local", generate_doi does not contact GBIF and no new export is written.

Configure the GBIF account credentials in the current R session with Sys.setenv(GBIF_USER = "your_username", GBIF_PWD = "your_password", GBIF_EMAIL = "your_account_email"). To keep them available in future sessions, add the same three variables to your personal ~/.Renviron file and restart R. Do not share or publish that file.

The default limit of 50,000 is intended to keep routine queries manageable. For species with larger occurrence sets, such as Amaranthus hybridus, reuse a local export or restrict the records with date. For a spatially filtered retrieval, use gbif_map_crop() or gbif_save_occurrences(): country areas and geometric boundaries are sent to GBIF before records are returned.

Interactive maps show the scientific name, year, locality, and observer (recordedBy) reported by GBIF for each occurrence. Missing values are displayed as unavailable.

Setting export_image = TRUE writes the static map as a PNG file, whatever the value of mode, to the same directory as the saved occurrences (sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species).

If GBIF cannot be reached (a transient network or server problem), an error explicitly worded as a communication failure is raised. It is distinct from the error raised when GBIF responds successfully but holds no georeferenced records for the species.

date selects occurrence datasets by their GBIF registry creation date (createdDate) and then filters records to those datasets; it is not the date when an individual occurrence was observed. This registry lookup is separate from the occurrence search. GBIF uses the Catalogue of Life Extended Release (COL XR) as the taxonomic reference for occurrence downloads. When generate_doi = TRUE, the export's metadata.json records its official download DOI and link. By downloading the data, you acknowledge GBIF's data-use agreement. When citing or referring to registered downloads (generate_doi = TRUE), follow GBIF's citation guidelines and include the DOI assigned to that specific download in every publication.

In Markdown reports, gbif_map_md() assigns a stable Quarto figure ID from the map type and species name. For "Bidens andicola", the full-extent map is fig-gbif-map-bidens_andicola. Use that ID in a cross-reference such as @fig-gbif-map-bidens_andicola. The caption identifies the accepted species and the date on which the map was produced. In Quarto or R Markdown, use results: asis for the chunk that calls an _md function so that the generated figure markup is interpreted by the document renderer.

Examples

# \donttest{
map <- gbif_map("Bidens andicola", limit = 100)
map_by_key <- gbif_map(taxon_id = "Q2M4", limit = 100)
map


# }
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
gbif_map("Bidens andicola", save_occurrences = TRUE, export_image = TRUE)
gbif_map("Bidens andicola", source = "local", mode = "static")

gbif_map_md("Bidens andicola", source = "web", mode = "interactive")
gbif_map_md("Bidens andicola", source = "web", mode = "static",
            limit = 500, export_image = TRUE, save_occurrences = TRUE)
gbif_map_md("Bidens andicola", source = "local", mode = "static",
            limit = 500, directory = getwd(), export_image = TRUE,
            colour = "#1B9E77", zoom_static = TRUE, dpi = 300,
            overwrite = TRUE, fig_width = 8, fig_height = 6)
} # }
